models.title: Anime Hero Character
models.description: A locally bundled, rigged anime character used in the Home hero. The GLB has no embedded animation clip, so the hero uses a slow camera orbit instead of invented character gestures.
models.animationInfo: No embedded animation clip. Home uses a gentle 7 degree-per-second camera orbit.

models.title: Character model slot
models.description: A place for a character exported from your 3D workflow. Add a packed GLB and an optional preview image when it is ready.

models.title: Product model slot
models.description: A place for a product or prop model with materials packed into a GLB.

models.title: Environment model slot
models.description: A place for a compact scene or environment prepared for real-time inspection.

models.title: Animated model slot
models.description: A place for a GLB that contains one or more animation clips.
models.animationInfo: Add clip names and playback notes after an animated model is supplied.
